documentation.description: Shows how much heap memory is currently being used by fielddata on every data node in the cluster.

fields.description: A comma-separated list of fields to return the fielddata size

aggregate.description: Comma-separated list of function(column) entries to compute for each group, where function is one of sum, count, avg, min or max. Without group_by, a single row over all rows is returned. h, s and limit then apply to the aggregated result.

format.description: a short version of the Accept header, e.g. json, yaml

bytes.description: The unit in which to display byte values

group_by.description: Comma-separated list of column names or column aliases to group by. Requires aggregate. The result has the group-by columns first, then the aggregate columns.

h.description: Comma-separated list of column names to display

limit.description: Maximum number of rows to return. Applied after sorting (s). Must be a positive integer.

s.description: Comma-separated list of column names or column aliases to sort by

fields.description: A comma-separated list of fields to return in the output
